clean_Help150_mechanics_binding.source_Japanese:
シェア（街データ）
特産品入荷量の何％を購入可能かを示します。売却は１％のシェアで、無制限に行えます。
シェアは[[23|商業投資]]・[[37|軍事投資]]・[[38|紹介状]]・[[39|推薦状]]で上げられます。ただし、最初の１％は王宮・総督府の[[36|契約]]で得る必要があります。
勢力の本拠地では、[[183|本拠地ポイント]]分のシェアがプラスされます。
→[[151|独占契約]]
clean_Help150_mechanics_binding.reviewed_English: Your market share determines how much of a city's specialty stock you can buy. A 1 percent share lets you sell without a limit. Increase your share through [[23|commercial investment]], [[37|military investment]], [[38|letters of introduction]] or [[39|letters of recommendation]]. You must obtain the first 1 percent through a [[36|contract]] at the Palace or Governor's Office. At your faction's home port, [[183|Home Port Points]] add to its share. See [[151|Exclusive Contracts]].
clean_Help150_mechanics_binding.relevance: Share limits purchases of local stock; no implication of a proportional selling cap
